title: 布隆·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 宽厚光头面容带着温和目光，巨大的棕色卷翘胡须格外醒目。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Braum is a very broad adult Freljordian man with a bald head, huge curled brown moustache, kind focused eyes, and an immense muscular build. Preserve his characteristic face and door-like carved shield while covering his torso with a substantial warm tunic beneath fur-edged outerwear, opaque trousers, gloves, and boots. The gigantic shield stands grounded beside him, held calmly without a blocking action.
art_direction.scene: A low viewpoint with a calm upward head turn, full iconic shape framed by a simple sweep of bright pencil hatching. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: snow ivory, cobalt shadow, warm brown, amber light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
